subject: English
question_text: Complete the following text with right forms of the verbs given in the box. 0.5  10 =
stimulus: accumulate be adulterate suffer stop hanker commit become go take Why do we always (a) ⎯⎯ from various diseases? Only for food adulteration. Food adulteration (b) ⎯⎯ a subject of great concern nowadays. In spite of Government’s sincere efforts, this evil practice has (c) ⎯⎯ yet. Still the act of (d) ⎯⎯ food is (e) ⎯⎯ on. Adulterated foods are (f) ⎯⎯ by people everyday. Consequently, the poison is (g) ⎯⎯ in our bodies day by day and it (h) ⎯⎯ very dangerous. The businessmen (i) ⎯⎯ after only money (j) ⎯⎯ this heinous deed.
guide_solution: (a) suffer (b) has become (c) not stopped (d) adulterating (e) going (f) taken (g) accumulating (h) is (i) hanker (j) committing
